heading: Who I Am
paragraphs: I'm a motivated and detail-oriented **Frontend Developer** with strong expertise in `React.js`, `JavaScript (ES6+)`, `HTML5`, `CSS3`, and `Tailwind CSS`. I'm passionate about building fast, responsive, and user-friendly web applications.
I'm adept at state management with **Redux**, component architecture, and version control using **Git/GitHub** — and I love shipping production-ready apps on **Vercel**.

I hold a **B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (2026)** and I'm currently working as a software engineer, building and improving production web applications. I'm looking for a full-time frontend role where I can keep shipping user-facing work.
